reason: The hypothesis relies on V reducing density (basic metallurgy, no citation needed) and on V enhancing strength/ductility in BCC RHEAs. E1 shows that adding Ti and V to ZrNbHf increases ideal tensile strength by 42% and substituting Hf with Ti and V increases it by ~170%, supporting the strengthening premise. However, E1 is an ab initio study of ideal strength, not experimental yield strength, and does not address density, high-temperature yield strength, or phase stability in the complex HfMoTaTiZr system. E2 is a methods excerpt from the same paper and adds no new evidence. E3 concerns HfMoNb
